name: Beams-TS-TW

frames.best_why: The white beams are at their brightest, standing as several upright glowing ribbons.

tagline: Upright ribbons of soft white light ripple and cross on black.
summary: A dark scene of tall, soft white light beams standing in a loose cluster, their edges rippling and drifting as if made of silk, with a faint grain over everything.
appearance: A black field with a cluster of upright, softly glowing white ribbons in the centre, of varying height and brightness, their edges blurred and slightly stepped. Some are bright bars, others faint halos, and light grain dusts the darker areas.
behaviour: The ribbons ripple and drift slowly upward and sideways, their bright bands sliding along each column like moving highlights. The motion loops continuously and never settles.
search_phrases: subtle light effect for a hero
use_when: You want a restrained, atmospheric light backdrop behind a dark hero without loud colour or busy motion.
avoid_when: The ribbons are dim and clustered, so on a bright screen they nearly vanish, and the effect never stops.
customise: Props set beam width, height and count, light colour, speed, noise intensity, scale and rotation. The spacing, shader material and camera are fixed in the source.
weight_why: A React Three Fiber canvas renders twelve noise-displaced planes on every frame.

a11y.note: The scene renders continuously and ignores reduced-motion; being decorative, it has no label.

issues: The ribbons are dim and clustered in the centre, leaving most of the frame black.
It ignores reduced-motion and never stops or pauses.
polish_why: Soft, atmospheric light ribbons, but dim and clustered with most of the frame empty.
title: Beams
